original_strong_form.statement: For every CNF, all residual states admit a polynomial-size continuation-complete Tear quotient.
original_strong_form.reason: Assigning X=a produces 2^n residual formulas over Y that are pairwise distinguishable by future continuations, although the input has O(n) clauses.

surviving_policy_form.warning: Constructing such a policy is already a polynomial-time SAT algorithm and would prove P=NP.
